reviews.title: Kept my buns from to much sun! Nice design and decent quality
reviews.body: Nice umbrella that was used at the beach. It was large enough for 2 people to be fully shaded. The steak and handle at the bottom is plastic so you will need to be careful not to break it but with attention and not to much force you should be ok. Now a little trick I did that worked great and kept my umbrella anchored well was taking some plastic grocery bags filling them with sand and hung them from the 4 prong hanger that was included. If I had not done this my umbrella would have flew away. I also loved how easily this broke down and went into a nice carrying case. The tilt feature is also a great feature. I was all in all happy with my purchase. I looked at many umbrellas and for my price point was the best. Last tip is keep your box that this comes in until you are sure you want to keep as I read many were unable to get a refund because they threw away the box.

reviews.title: When you have to tell your wife that the beach vacation isn't going to happen....
reviews.body: Perfect for the consolation beach area in the back yard for my wife. If you have to tell her the beach vacation isn't going to happen, build her a mini beach at home for 1/10th of the price that vacation was going to run!The beach umbrella really brought everything together.  The screw drive for installing it worked great.  I had doubts with all of the plastic parts,  but it dug right through the sand and geotextile barrier. It even worked right through the clay beneath that.It is in a semi- sheltered area,  but it has held up just fine through a few thunderstorms- even after I forgot to close it.After a few months,  the latch for bringing down the umbrella section doesn't want to work.  There might be some sand stuck in there though.

reviews.title: Good for use on grass and maybe for the beach too
reviews.body: I bought this umbrella to use at our local swim club which has grass surrounding the pool.  I had to buy a separate $15 piece to securely anchor the umbrella into the ground, which I knew when I bought the umbrella.  So far the umbrella has stood up well in the wind.  It comes with a corkscrew anchor for use in the sand which I haven't tried yet.  The umbrella is lightweight and comes in a carrying case with a strap.  It sets up easily and provides good shade.  So far, it's a good value for the price paid.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 17, 2025
reviews.author: Kindle User

reviews.title: A must for the beach
reviews.body: I bought 2 and they worked great on the beach. I used them about 5 days total. I angled them a bit and used a bungie to attach it to the cooler just in case on days that the winds were higher. I could see how the plastic side twists on the anchor could break if twisting in hard sand with too much pressure, but mine held because I was careful. It would have been nice if there was room in the bag to carry everything including the anchor or a strap on the outside of the bag to secure it so it stays together and easy to carry. One provided enough shade for 2 people. I was happy with my purchase and would recommend it.
